description: Per-request structured log line emitted by every AnomalyPulse service.
emission_rules: Every service emits exactly one JSON log line per request.
Every correlation and tier1_observable field is always present.
If a field does not apply to a service, emit it as null. Never omit it.
tier2_ground_truth fields are NEVER emitted on the request path, only by the incident simulator.
tier2_ground_truth fields are joined to telemetry data by request_id and timestamp for labeling and evaluation ONLY.
The feature-engineering build guard must fail the build if any tier2_ground_truth field name appears in training data.

correlation._note: Identity and timing. Emitted by every service. Used for window agg and ordering ONLY, NOT model training.

tier1_observable._note: Things a areal monitoring system could see WITHOUT knowing the cause. Aggregate before using for model training.

latency_ms.note: End-to-end wall clock time for the request as seen by the handler.

lambda_duration_ms.note: Compute time of the Lambda body itself.

cold_start.note: True if this invocation paid a cold-start penalty.

db_latency_ms.note: DynamoDB call time. Null for services that make no DB call (Payment).

db_consumed_capacity.note: DynamoDB consumed capacity units for this request. Null when no DB call.

dependency.note: Downstream service called. Null when none (Product, Cart, Payment).

dependency_latency_ms.note: Measured call time to the dependency. Null when none (Product, Cart, Payment).

dependency_error.note: True if dependency call failed or timed out.

tier2_ground_truth._note: FORBIDDEN as features and NEVER emitted on the request path. Used ONLY for labeling/evaluation.

db_throttled.note: This is NOT the observable ThrottledRequests COUNT from CloudWatch, aggregated over window of time.

fault_injection_params.note: The exact knobs the simulator set for this experiment (intensity, multiplier, added latency, etc.).
